title: Define the alpha release contract
summary: Define what an alpha release must truthfully include before Covenant is presented as installable agent-native operating-layer infrastructure.
expectedFailureModes: The project claims alpha readiness without naming supported platforms, commands, or known unsafe edges.
Release docs imply sandbox, settlement, or provenance guarantees that are still experimental.
Contributors cannot tell which gaps block an alpha tag versus later research work.
humanEscalation: Human approval before tagging or publishing an actual release artifact
nextAction: Write the alpha release contract, mark unsupported claims explicitly, and separate release blockers from post-alpha research.
